title: Postgres move envelope ladder
goal: Work toward the user-facing dream of machinen move save <source-vm> <postgres-pid> pg.bundle and machinen move load <target-vm> pg.bundle by implementing and proving a narrow, explicit PostgreSQL move envelope through the existing machinen move command, without claiming generic PostgreSQL or process teleportation.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove the existing PostgreSQL move behavior remains fail-closed through machinen move before adding support: save/load for unsupported PostgreSQL process state refuses before target launch, with loaderStarted=false or no target pid evidence.
proofChecklist.evidence: Existing PostgreSQL move behavior remains fail-closed through machinen move. proofChecklist.obligation: Prove the real PostgreSQL process/resource shape in the proof VM is documented from command evidence, including postmaster, child processes, sockets, shared memory, open files, WAL paths, locks, data directory, config files, package identity, and owner/mode assumptions.
proofChecklist.evidence: Inspected a real proof-provisioned PostgreSQL 15 process in a Machinen proof VM and retained artifacts under /tmp/postgres-move-ladder-inspect. Setup used postgresql-15/postgresql-client-15/procps proof packages, initdb -D /tmp/pgdata-proof --auth=trust --no-locale, and postgres -D /tmp/pgdata-proof -p 8159 -h 127.0.0.1. Evidence from resource-shape.txt: package identity postgresql-15 15.18-0+deb12u1 arm64, client 15.18-0+deb12u1, postgresql-common 248+deb12u1; process tree postmaster pid 2685 plus checkpointer, background writer, walwriter, autovacuum launcher, logical replication launcher; exe=/usr/lib/postgresql/15/bin/postgres; cwd=/tmp/pgdata-proof; fd table includes /dev/null, /tmp/postgres-proof.log, /dev/kmsg, sockets, and pipe; maps show /dev/zero deleted and SYSV shared memory mappings; /proc/net/tcp shows listener 127.0.0.1:8159; ipcs shows shared memory segments owned by postgres; data dir stat postgres:postgres uid/gid 100:102 mode 700; config shas recorded for PG_VERSION, postgresql.conf, pg_hba.conf, global/pg_control; tree identity has 993 entries and digest c3f122ca9c608075d7526417d12f5ffa5a6d00aa72904f68c5727969ea3f2f99; lock/runtime files include postmaster.pid and postmaster.opts; WAL contains 000000010000000000000001; SQL state evidence: version PostgreSQL 15.18 on aarch64, backends=6, prepared=0, slots=0, tablespaces=0, unlogged=0. This proves real Postgres uses process graph, sockets, shared memory, WAL, lock/runtime files, and data-dir/config identity that must be explicitly modeled or refused.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove the first support envelope is explicitly documented as a narrow machinen move contract: idle PostgreSQL cluster, no active clients, clean checkpoint or equivalent safe boundary, no unsafe features, target-native Debian PostgreSQL restart, and visible target psql SELECT 1 evidence; no generic process/VM/ELF/runtime restore claim.

proofChecklist.evidence: Remote amd64 validation did not pass; a concrete blocker was recorded and no remote PostgreSQL success is claimed. First attempted wrapper command: MACHINEN_MOVE_REMOTE_OUT=/tmp/postgres-move-framework-remote scripts/smoke/move-envelope-remote-amd64.sh, elapsed 11.984s, failed before matrix proofs because rsync had overwritten packages/microvm/zig-out/bin/machinen-vm with a Mach-O arm64 binary on the Linux remote; diagnostics showed packages/native-x64-linux/vmm/bin/gvproxy was ELF x86-64. Then ran direct remote probe on root@192.168.0.8 from /mnt/shared-500G/machinen-move-proof with Linux ELF overrides MACHINEN_VMM=$PWD/packages/native-x64-linux/vmm/bin/machinen-vm and MACHINEN_GVPROXY=$PWD/packages/native-x64-linux/vmm/bin/gvproxy. file output proved both were ELF x86-64. Probe boot wrote /tmp/postgres-move-remote-amd64/probe.json with pid=3812683/name=move-remote-probe-postgres-3812660, but node packages/cli/dist/cli.js exec ... uname -m failed in 31.533s with EXEC_AGENT_UNAVAILABLE: VsockExec.run: agent did not respond within 30000ms: write EPIPE. A retry probe wrote /tmp/postgres-move-remote-amd64/probe-retry.json with pid=3813032/name=move-remote-probe-retry-3812995 and failed the same uname exec in 33.492s with EXEC_AGENT_UNAVAILABLE/write EPIPE. Remote diagnostics showed both VMs registered and running with native-x64-linux/machinen-vm and gvproxy, uname output files were empty, and no PostgreSQL matrix proofs ran. The two remote probe VMs were stopped and node packages/cli/dist/cli.js list --json returned an empty VM list. This is recorded as a remote exec-agent blocker, not a remote envelope success.

A target loader can start before all required PostgreSQL safety gates pass.
Support would require proof-only tools to be baked into base assets instead of proof VMs or disposable proof overlays.

A required validation command fails and cannot be fixed within the current goal scope.
